source_refs.note: Sub-heading 'Wired Network Connections' of 1.9 as printed (PDF 17, printed 12).

blocks.text: A wired network uses cables to connect devices. Ethernet cables are commonly used in wired networks. Devices are connected directly to a router or switch. Wired connections provide high speed and stable performance. These networks are more secure than wireless networks. However, devices cannot move freely because of cables.
